text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo~! It's Ines Fuujin! Once 
again, I'll be in your care starting 
today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I have part-time shifts here and there, 
but I'll schedule them around training, so 
don't hold back, whip me into shape!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my family who always 
cheers me on, I'm gonna do my very best in 
both races and part-time jobs~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
